description.content: This resource represents a payer in the healthcare system. A payer refers to an entity that finances or reimburses the cost of health services. Use it to get, create, and update payers.
Returns a list of payers for the provided tenant. The payers are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent payers appearing first.

query.description: Optional name to filter the list of payers. The search is case-insensitive and partial.
